messages:
Nina: quick capture from onboarding calls 1 recurring asks: per-route billing toggle hidden, no simple cost examples, and a request for team-scoped API keys.
Nina: verbatim: "Couldn't find per-route billing toggle 1 stalled setup" (GreenPark), "How much is 100k tokens?" (Orbit), "We need team API keys for staging" (Helix).
Caleb: counts + renewal risk?
Nina: GreenPark is paid, renewal in 3w 1 high risk; Orbit is a pilot (2 teams), Helix is a trial with security asking.
Tori: product/UX idea: surface toggle on route list with a small badge + inline tooltip linking to a cost-preview page. low-effort: ~1 dev day + 0.5 ux day.
Sam: enablement: I'll script a 60s screencast and two short templates (paying vs pilot). 48h.
Nina: requested a simple cost-per-10k/100k tokens matrix from billing; will paste when available.
Sam: team-API-keys is larger (auth + RBAC) 1 backlog it under security/api and surface in roadmap triage.
Ezra-bot: CS-99901 created: "Onboard: surface per-route billing toggle + cost-preview + enablement assets" assigned to Tori, priority P1, due 3d.
Caleb: I'll mark GreenPark as at-risk in the renewal tracker and schedule a 15m walkthrough.
Nina: thanks all 1 small UX changes here could materially shift renewal outcome. :raised_hands:
